{{Top|leg}}
The '''EMP-X1 field array''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] system produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The EMP-X1 emitted an electromagnetic pulse that disabled enemy drones and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components within a large radius for a duration.
